source: RECORDED from Claude Code CLI 2.1.322 via claude-agent-sdk 0.2.168 (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-11-12: two Monitor calls in one message (a short one that ends by itself after four output lines, a long one stopped with TaskStop). A Monitor is announced as TaskStarted(task_type=local_bash) carrying the Monitor tool_use_id; each output line wakes the CLI as a turn of its own whose ResultMessage.origin.kind is task-notification and which carries no Task* frame; the source ending is TaskUpdated(completed) plus TaskNotification(completed, summary 'Monitor ... stream ended'); TaskStop is TaskUpdated(killed) plus TaskNotification(stopped). Ids shortened and only the fields the adapter reads kept. The frames after the end and stop notifications were not kept here (this fixture is not evidence about what follows them); background_ends.json records those sequences untrimmed.

input.command: for i in 1 2 3 4; do echo A-tick-$i; sleep 4; done

tool_result.content: Monitor started (task task-a, expires in 1m unless the source ends first; you get one notice at expiry). You will be notified on each event.

input.command: for i in $(seq 1 40); do echo B-tick-$i; sleep 5; done

tool_result.content: Monitor started (task task-b, expires in 5m unless the source ends first; you get one notice at expiry). You will be notified on each event.
